metadata.case_name: HUANG PEI NAM v. CHEUNG SAI KIT

plaintiff.occupation_before: employed by a relative who was the sole proprietor of a provisions store in Sai Kung
plaintiff.occupation_after: employed by a relative who was the sole proprietor of a provisions store in Sai Kung
plaintiff.education_level: completed full high school education before leaving China

injuries.description: A 2 inch haematoma with laceration to the skull.
source: A 2 inch haematoma with laceration to the skull.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Numerous lacerations and abrasions to the face, trunk, arms and right leg.
source: Numerous lacerations and abrasions to the face, trunk, arms and right leg.

injuries.description: Loss of consciousness with temporary amnesia.
source: Loss of consciousness with temporary amnesia.
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with incomplete loss of consciousness with amnesia

injuries.description: Severe memory disturbance / brain damage with a high risk of epileptic or cerebral seizures and severe intellectual and emotional loss consistent with brain damage.
source: picture of a young man who has suffered a severe memory disturbance with a high risk of epileptic or cerebral seizures eventuating within the first five years after the accident.
Dr. Green has concluded that the plaintiff has suffered a severe intellectual and emotional loss consistent with brain damage.

manifestations.description: Loss of consciousness with temporary amnesia
High risk of epileptic or cerebral seizures eventuating within the first five years after the accident
Loss of Spontaneity: The plaintiff has become withdrawn and there is an absence of the usual curiosity in new experiences or places.
Emotional Loss: The paucity of emotion which has resulted creates a barrier to the plaintiff's ability to socialize with other people in a normal way.
Communication: The plaintiff exhibits a tendency to confuse or misinterpret what is said or asked of him. His responses are accordingly confused.
Intellectual Deterioration: Lack of concentration and an inability to grasp simple concepts.
Frustration: Irritability and tension displayed when he finds he is unable to perform a task resulting in abandonment of attempts.
Pain associated with multiple lacerations and abrasions.

treatments_received: neurosurgical examinations with Dr. John Hunter

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities including severe intellectual and emotional loss consistent with brain damage; deprivation of many abilities and pleasures which he could otherwise have expected to benefit from and enjoy. Judge awarded $90,000 under this head.
Loss of future earning capacity assessed as ($900 x 12 x 15) = $162,000 due to reduced capacity to perform work and diminished prospects.
